comment: Machine-readable publishability and verification classification. Packages with status 'publishable' must pass every gate (build, typecheck, lint, unit tests). Packages with status 'excluded' are not published and are skipped by the verification gate with an explicit machine-readable reason. This file is the single source of truth consumed by scripts/verify-workspace.mjs.
